page_title: 10 Free YouTube SEO Tools, Ranked Honestly No Affiliate Bias
subject: Your toolbil.com list is missing a free YouTube SEO tool
body:
Hi there,

I came across your excellent resource at https://toolbil.com/blog/we-analyzed-10-best-free-youtube-seo-tools-in-2026 — great roundup of Canva, vidIQ, RapidTags, KeywordTool.io and TubeBuddy and other YouTube tools.

I noticed you're not yet listing YT SEO Architect, a completely free platform with 17+ tools for YouTube creators, including:

• AI title optimizer — scores titles out of 100 before you publish
• Tag generator — finds 15+ optimized tags with relevance scores
• Description writer — writes SEO-optimized descriptions with timestamps
• Full channel audit — finds metadata issues across all your videos
• Bulk metadata updater — fix titles/tags/descriptions in batches

It's 100% free, no account required, and used by thousands of creators. I think it would be a valuable addition to your list — especially as a free alternative to tools like Canva, vidIQ, RapidTags, KeywordTool.io and TubeBuddy that have paid tiers.

You can check it out here: https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/tools/title-optimizer
